selection_rationale: CPU-only NEURON+BoTorch task (no GPU needed). Selected offer 31574004: AMD EPYC 7B13 64-core (cpu_cores_effective=64, billed as 61.4-core cgroup quota), 503 GB host RAM, 25 GB container disk, $0.1582/hr in Norway (reliability 0.9970, 407-day duration). Cheapest qualifying offer with cpu_cores_effective>=64 cpu_ram>=64 reliability>0.995 dph<0.30 rentable=true. Estimated 124,000 NEURON simulations at the t0076 empirical rate (21.67 core-s/trial * 1.10 AIS overhead / 64 workers = 12.8 h wall-clock for the BO loop) = $1.91 compute + $0.16 prov+teardown overhead + 20% contingency for 49d GP fitting = $2.06-$2.47 total. Closely matches the t0076 instance profile (Xeon E5-2686 v4, 72 cores, 96 GB RAM, $0.16/hr) on price and topology but with substantially more RAM (503 vs 96 GB) and 64 vs 72 effective cores. The single idle RTX 5060 Ti GPU is not used by this task; we pay for the host slice only. Total cost remains well under the $5.00 per-task limit and within the user-authorized $2.50-$4.00 envelope from the t0077 brainstorm session 13.

ssh_notes: Vast.ai SSH proxy auto-attaches a tmux session on TTY logins. Disabled for this instance via 'touch /root/.no_auto_tmux' so plain ssh -p 28066 root@ssh2.vast.ai 'cmd' works for stdin-piped commands. SCP works via 'ssh2.vast.ai:28066'. The implementation step can SSH directly with 'ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 -p 28066 root@ssh2.vast.ai'.
